question: On64fresh ordinary prime-field curves, can verified monotone reuse of failed Bernstein-Lange endpoints improve complete setup-plus-solve EC group invocation counts under one fixed known-plus-pending endpoint arena?

claims.text: Every claimed scalar answer and every promoted endpoint satisfies the registered public equations and causal verification boundary.
At64targets per cell, harvest uses fewer complete solver-API group_additions than static_filled on the registered paired panel.
claims.if_supported: A measured group-invocation improvement at this cohort/reuse/memory scope only; full field/native/RSS costs remain visible.
claims.if_not_supported: Retain exact costs and uncertainty; revise the implementation/regime without retiring the mechanism family.

claims.text: Novelty of the endpoint-reuse family, an overall runtime speedup and an asymptotic exponent improvement are outside this experiment.

hypotheses.statement: At the registered finite reuse and cap, certified endpoint reuse may reduce complete EC group invocation work relative to the charged distinct-filled staticBL reference while preserving correctness.
hypotheses.mechanism: A failed terminal D=Q+[a]G becomes a known scalar endpoint e=x+a mod r only after [x]G=Q verifies; later targets reuse it within a fixed C-slot arena.

predictions.minimum_effect: Primary equal-curve geometric mean ratio and its95% cluster-bootstrap upper endpoint below1, with passing exact A/A and witness controls; no runtime inference.

data_seen.measured: Earlier48curve/768target baseline and prefixcandidate costs, different frozen method/cohort.
Prior actual generic growth/reselection runs and open EC follow-up, not merely stale hypothesis status; exact source audit retained separately.

PerQ upstream workstop256*ceil_sqrt(r)+8192 and per cellbuildstop256*C*(1<<t)+8192, plus unchanged512attempt cap. These are APIreported work units, not full cost bounds; limits and3600s childwatchdog are operational censoring, not mathematical failure.

invalidation_rules: Wrong public witness, unauthorized promotion, cap violation, source/input/seed mismatch or failed mandatory control invalidates affected implementation/measurement; preserve raw records.
A missing/censored/invalid member of the primary pair makes the full registered paired improvement undefined; do not replace it with a success-only claim.
Clocks without observedL2/tierB+ or acrossrestore/contended/interrupted rows stay wall_validfalse and do not qualify a runtime comparison.

The frozen public solver seed law permits zero; the current native parser rejects a zero seed. Retain that child failure and all affected incomplete outcomes as infrastructure/implementation incompletion; never redraw a nonce, replace the seed, retry until favorable, or interpret it as mathematical failure.

decision_rule.text: Report correctness, all counters and memory first. The finite primary group-invocation improvement is eligible only with complete verified primary pairs, public endpoint trace/cap controls and exactA/A equality, and primarym64 harvest/static_filled gmean ratio with95%cluster-bootstrap upper endpoint<1. Other outcomes remain observations for the next revision.
decision_rule.threshold: Complete registered primary panel, passing controls, primary ratioCIupper<1; no hidden fallback.
decision_rule.statistic: For eachcurve sum bothreplicate complete group_additions, form candidate/baseline ratio; equal-curve geometricmean and range.
decision_rule.interval: 10000 bootstrap resamples of64curves withreplacement preserving both replicates/all prefixes/comparisons; pointwise percentile95%, linear quantiles.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Complete solver-API EC group invocation ratio and absolute counter difference; full native costvector and memory separate.
